description: This file defines API endpoints for managing agent entities within a larger system, including functionality for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and publishing agents, as well as retrieving agent daily activity. It uses FastAPI for web routing and depends on external modules for data persistence and authorization.

methods.name: get_agents( request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of agents, with filtering based on user roles and permissions, and adds visibility status.

methods.name: create_agent( request: AgentConfig, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new agent with validation for naming conflicts and registration.

methods.name: get_agent_by_id(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific agent by its ID, checking both in-memory registry and database.

methods.name: update_agent( agent_id: str, request: AgentConfig, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates an existing agent, handling both in-memory and database updates, with error handling.

methods.name: patch_agent( agent_id: str, request: PatchAgentRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Partially updates an existing agent's configuration, similar to full update but for patch semantics.

methods.name: delete_agent(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Removes an agent from the database and registry.

methods.name: make_agent_public( agent_id: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Adds an agent to the public group, updating system configuration accordingly.

methods.name: make_agents_public( request: MakeAgentsPublicRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Batch operation to add multiple agents to the public group, updating configuration.

methods.name: get_agent_daily_activity( agent_ids: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, exclude_agent_ids: Optional[str] = None, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves daily activity data for specific agents or all accessible agents, supporting filters and pagination.
